# madfam-site — full LLM context

Generated: 2026-09-04 (curated — this file was the generic template until this
date and described no package, app, route or script).

## Purpose

A stable, tool-agnostic map for working in this repository without depending on
vendor-specific instruction files.

## Canonical instruction order

1. `AGENTS.md` — canonical. Contains the repo-boundary contract.
2. `llms.txt` — the compact index.
3. `docs/development/ARCHITECTURE.md`
4. `ECOSYSTEM.md`, `README.md`
5. Task-relevant files under `docs/`, `k8s/`, `infra/`, `.github/workflows/`
   and the source tree.

`CLAUDE.md` exists only to redirect Claude and other legacy agent integrations
to `AGENTS.md`. It carries no policy, and neither should any file that is not
`AGENTS.md`.

## What this repository is

The MADFAM corporate website — `madfam.io`. It is a pnpm + Turborepo monorepo
on Next.js, shipping Spanish, English and Portuguese. (A Payload CMS app,
`apps/cms`, is retired — ruling R52, 2026-09-23 — and no longer deployed.)

It is **Lane C: a public corporate-site repository**.

## Repo-boundary contract

- `internal-devops` *(private, Lane A)* is the canonical source for production
  topology, node identity, capacity, costs, secrets, incident evidence, client
  engagements and operational runbooks.
- `solarpunk-foundry` *(public, Lane B)* is the designated public ecosystem
  contract repo, permanently public by owner statement (2026-09-04). The
  canonical cross-repo ecosystem map lives there.
- This repo keeps marketing surface, public product copy, and the code that
  renders them.

**Never write into this repo:** node hostnames, public IP addresses, hardware
models or capacity figures, Cloudflare tunnel identifiers, Vault paths or secret
names with retrieval detail, cost ledgers, internal rates, revenue or ROI
projections, incident diagnoses and evidence trails, client identities or
engagement detail, operator local paths, or any live credential.

**Public and staying public:** the topology shape — a 4-node bare-metal k3s
cluster (one control plane, one worker, two CI builders), ingress through a
single Cloudflare Tunnel with zero exposed node ports, Longhorn CSI block
storage, Cloudflare R2 object storage, ArgoCD GitOps with self-heal.

Checklist: `docs/PUBLIC_REPO_BOUNDARY.md`. Policy:
`internal-devops/docs/repo-boundary-contract.md`. Two CI guards enforce part of
it — `scripts/public-hygiene-check.sh` and `scripts/boundary-checkpoint-check.sh`,
run by `.github/workflows/public-hygiene.yml`. Read their `classes_skipped=` and
`source=` output: a green run is not proof a change is boundary-clean.

## Applications

- **`apps/web`** — the Next.js site. Every route is locale-prefixed under
  `apps/web/app/[locale]/`; `getLocalizedUrl()` is the navigation helper and
  middleware handles locale detection. Shared server logic is in
  `apps/web/lib/` (`environment.ts`, `seo.ts`, `rate-limit.ts`, `redis.ts`,
  `security.ts`, `cms/`, `data/`).
- **`apps/cms`** — retired Payload app (R52): not deployed. The web app enables
  its CMS client only when `NEXT_PUBLIC_CMS_URL` is set (production does not
  set it); blog and case-study routes render shipped i18n content.

## Packages

- `packages/core` — business logic, feature flags, logger.
- `packages/i18n` — translations for es, en and pt. Parity across the three
  locales is checked by `pnpm check:translations`.
- `packages/analytics` — Plausible integration.
- `packages/email` — templates and the Resend sender.
- `packages/ui` — themes and design tokens only. UI components are app-owned:
  `solarpunk-foundry/docs/architecture/SELF_CONTAINED_SERVICES.md` (2026-07-25)
  ratified shared contracts and infrastructure, per-app UI and theming.

## Key data files

- `apps/web/lib/data/projection.public.json` — the vendored public projection
  of the ecosystem product registry, and the source of truth for which products
  exist (hosts, licences, lifecycle, commerce tiers). Never hand-edit it;
  re-vendor it byte-identical from the registry (AGENTS.md, "Re-vendoring the
  registry projection").
- `apps/web/lib/data/platforms.generated.ts` — generated from the projection by
  `pnpm generate:platforms` (`pnpm check:platforms` guards freshness);
  `platforms.presentation.ts` is the hand-kept overlay that decides which
  registry products the site surfaces; `platforms.ts` merges them into
  `PLATFORMS`. Count the catalog there rather than trusting a number in prose.
- `apps/web/lib/data/value-ladder.ts` — the public value-ladder structure.
- `packages/i18n/src/translations/{en,es,pt}/*.json` — every user-visible
  string, including the platform copy.

## Styling

Tailwind v4. Design tokens live in the `@theme` block in
`apps/web/app/globals.css`. **`tailwind.config.ts` is inert** — no `@config`
directive exists, so anything added there silently emits nothing. A utility that
produces no CSS is usually one that exists only in that file.

## Commands

`pnpm dev`, `pnpm build`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint`,
`pnpm format`, `pnpm check:translations`, `pnpm validate:translations`,
`pnpm find:missing-translations`. There is no `pnpm analyze`.

## Scripts

`scripts/check-networkpolicy-ports.py`, `security-check.js`,
`validate-translations.js`, `find-missing-translations.js`,
`split-translations.js`, `finalize-file-splitting.js`, `split-dev-guide.js`,
`split-ui-docs.js`, `split-ui-docs-improved.js`, `security-fixes.sh`,
`public-hygiene-check.sh`, `boundary-checkpoint-check.sh`,
`tests/test-public-hygiene.sh`.

## Deployment

**Enclii only.** Push to `main` → GitHub Actions builds → GHCR → a digest commit
into `k8s/production` → ArgoCD syncs. MADFAM has completely migrated off Vercel
(owner confirmation, 2026-09-04) and the Vercel configuration was deleted from
this repository on that date. Any document describing a Vercel deploy path is
historical and is banner-labelled as such.

## Enclii-first operations contract

Use Enclii web, API, or CLI for routine production provisioning, deployment,
observability, domain management, secrets, provider operations, scaling,
rollback, and remediation.

Raw `kubectl`, `helm`, SSH, provider CLIs/APIs, `docker exec`, and direct
container access are allowed only for platform bootstrap or documented
break-glass emergencies when Enclii is unavailable or lacks an implemented
adapter. Any break-glass use must record the actor, reason, target
service/environment, commands executed, result, and the follow-up Enclii
adapter gap or incident link.

## Secrets

Keep environment examples placeholder-only. Never add live credentials,
base64-encoded secrets, token-shaped examples or production webhook URLs to
docs, templates, workflow logs, issues, PRs, or agent chat.

## Maintenance

`internal-devops/scripts/sync-agent-docs.py` keeps the agent-doc set coherent.
It preserves curated `llms.txt` and `llms-full.txt` rather than overwriting them,
which is why this file is hand-written. Repo-specific long-form guidance belongs
in `AGENTS.md`, never in `CLAUDE.md`.
